scope.geography: Japanese islands outside the Izu development region
scope.interpretation: external retrospective generalization of the frozen robust support envelope; not prospective detection-probability validation

cohort.sampling_rule: within each island frame, after all historical-development and 192-pair exclusions, split eligible species into two rank-based record-count strata and sample exactly one unused taxon per stratum; taxa are globally unique and are never replaced after declaration

retrospective_split.failure_rule: declared pair/repeat failures remain in intention-to-evaluate denominator as zero; no taxon replacement or threshold change

frozen_method.candidate_land_universe: GSI DEM-supported land grid; generalized with the same public GSI terrain acquisition path used by ACSP
frozen_method.ndvi_source: ESA WorldCover annual Sentinel-2 NDVI composite 2021 v200
frozen_method.feature_scaling: training-prototype median and IQR within each inner world
frozen_method.inner_consensus: median support rank across leave-one-training-prototype-out worlds

comparators.primary: same-island random cells matched exactly to the frozen support-envelope selected-cell count
secondary: single-world nearest-prototype support using the same frozen threshold
uniform spatial cells matched to selected-cell count
comparators.sdm: optional secondary if implemented once with a frozen fair island-specific extent; SDM performance cannot alter the frozen support method

estimands.primary: held-out 500m cluster recall within 1 km of the frozen support envelope
estimands.sensitivity: held-out 500m cluster recall within 0.5 km using the frozen sensitivity threshold
estimands.random_lift: frozen support recall minus mean matched-random recall
estimands.coverage_cost: selected support cells divided by candidate land-grid cells

inference.claim_rule: report mean paired lift, pair-bootstrap 95% interval, and pair-level sign-flip p; no superiority/generalization claim if CI crosses zero or p>=0.05; negative results are retained and the method is not retuned

claim_boundaries.can_support: cross-taxon retrospective transfer of an occurrence-conditioned robust survey-support envelope on island domains
cannot_support: robust finite Top-k or patch compression
